title: When the Parish Wakes
author: Gideon Eriksen
blurb: Coral Yarrow, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has spent five years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
